phase_note: Fase 1 (00–07): fondasi → metrik → UI → WhatsApp → Odoo → agen v1 → Orchestrator → MCP. Fase 2 (08–14): peta relasi, agen v2, memori & kalibrasi, pengaturan, eksekusi nyata, hardening, pilot.

stages.name: Fondasi: monorepo, Postgres, migrasi, seed, Makefile, CI
stages.summary: Monorepo Go (cmd/arc api·worker·ctl, chi, pgx, goose, river, sqlc) + web Vite/React 19 dengan token & CSS mockup; migrasi 0001 (semua tabel 03-data-model + commitments) & 0002 river; seed 18 dealer dari mockup via tools/seedgen (idempoten); /api/health, /api/me (X-Dev-User), heartbeat river; make dev/check/migrate/seed/sqlc; CI.
stages.notes: Tanpa Docker: Postgres 17 native + DATABASE_URL_TEST skema per test (ADR 0006). Proyek di subfolder distri-arc-kit/ (kode ARC v1 di repo induk belum dihapus — butuh keputusan Sam).

stages.name: Domain & metrics engine (rumus Orbit) + API baca dealer
stages.summary: internal/domain + internal/metrics (siklus order median, status, aktivitas, segmen, SOW, product mix, sisa limit, pola bayar, tepat waktu, PIC aktif, skor 5 komponen, KPI, push kandidat, rekomendasi order); 16 kasus glossary + uji properti; seed regression: 18 dealer = mockup (toleransi 0); job metrics.recompute (10 mnt) & metrics.snapshot (00.30 WIB); API baca dealers/orbit/segmen/due/drift/credit-tight/kpi/agenda/stock/credit; arc ctl metrics.
stages.notes: KPI dihitung dari rumus: order tepat jadwal 81% (mockup 85%), DSO 30 hr kredit-saja (mockup 36), perputaran stok 46 hr, lewat tempo Rp 141 jt. Skor dihitung tanpa FMA agar pembulatan x,5 sama dengan rumus acuan.

stages.name: Frontend shell + Pusat kendali (baca) + Orbit/Segmen/Dealer
stages.summary: Shell React persis mockup (rail, topbar + view tabs, ⌘K, tabbar, dock, toast, sheet; CSS mockup verbatim); Pusat kendali (baca: hero, Orchestrator card, ringkasan template /brief/today, jadwal order, lewat jadwal, KPI utama, agenda sales, push stok, limit tipis), Orbit (SVG + anti-tabrak), Segmen (log-Y, zona, titik 3 bulan lalu), Dealer (semua bagian); SSE /api/events; vitest 11 + Playwright 13 (6 rute × 1440/390, tanpa scroll horizontal).
stages.notes: Rencana hari ini, Keputusan, dan tombol aksi menampilkan empty state "menunggu Orchestrator (Stage 06)". Layar Orchestrator/Chat/Peta relasi/Push stok/Kredit/Pengaturan/Panduan berupa placeholder sampai tahapnya. Screenshot di web/e2e/__screenshots__.

stages.name: WhatsApp ingest (whatsmeow + Cloud API), nomor internal, grup, Chat
stages.summary: internal/wa: Transport (fake, whatsmeow QR multi-device + riwayat, Cloud API webhook+Graph) dan ingest idempoten dengan filter privasi (DM internal dibuang, grup internal tanpa dampak ke dealer, nomor baru → thread baru); worker: ingest streaming, wa.pair, outbox.send (batas harian, jeda acak, balasan manusia); API Chat + nomor internal + grup + status/pair; Chat 3 panel & Pengaturan persis mockup; arc ctl wa inject.
stages.notes: Tanpa nomor uji: transport fake. whatsmeow belum diuji dengan ponsel nyata; enkripsi sesi WA_SESSION_KEY belum (ADR 0007). Riwayat WA sintetis hanya sebagai sinyal.

stages.name: Odoo sync read-only, order-to-cash, SO draft (off)
stages.summary: internal/odoo: Source (JSON-RPC execute_kw + Fake dari db/seed/odoo, 13 model diekspor seedgen), syncer idempoten (kursor write_date per model, partner→dealer/kontak, produk+harga tier, SO+baris→orders, picking/invoice/pembayaran→order-to-cash, quant→stok, sinyal model:id:write_date), job odoo.sync 10 mnt, arc ctl odoo sync|test, SO draft (ODOO_WRITE=false menolak), API /connections + kategori, panel Odoo di Pengaturan.
stages.notes: Tanpa kredensial Odoo: ODOO_MODE=fake. Pemetaan field nyata (credit_limit, pricelist tier, industry/segmen, margin_percent, velocity) perlu dikonfirmasi pada instance GSI.

stages.name: LLM provider + Agen v1 (Order, Follow-up, Kredit) + proposal & keputusan
stages.summary: internal/llm: Provider (Anthropic beta Messages + structured output + server-side fallback, OpenAI cadangan, Fake deterministik), Router (masking PII, unmask, validasi, tidak pernah gagal → template, log llm_calls dengan biaya Rp), prompt system/followup/order/kredit. internal/agents: AI Order (ekstraksi intent+item dari WA → so_draft/credit_hold, price_counter dengan floor margin, retur), AI Follow-up (H-1, 2–7 hari, lewat jadwal + akar terduga), AI Kredit (rilis kredit SOP-SEC-001 + DP 50%, naik limit). internal/proposals: runner (expire, dedupe, supresi kalibrasi, otonom hanya SO draft lengkap & credit hold), Decide (RBAC CEO/finance, alasan tolak wajib → kalibrasi 14 hari, approve/edit → outbox WA atau Odoo note/SO draft, audit + NOTIFY). API /proposals, /proposals/{id}, /decide, /calibration, /dealers/{id}/next. Web: antrian Keputusan, ActionSheet (sumber, kenapa sekarang, edit draft, tolak dengan alasan), tombol aksi di daftar/dealer/chat, Kalibrasi agen di Pengaturan.
stages.notes: Tanpa ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: LLM_PROVIDER=fake (alasan & draft dari template agen, confidence template). Seed → 13 proposal (credit_release Graha DP 50%, followup Prima/Jaya/Borneo H-1, price_counter Indo Vision, so_draft Toko Sinar otonom, dst). Uji UI: setujui follow-up Prima → outbox sent ±1 dtk via wa.Fake + audit_log; tolak dengan "Tidak sesuai kebijakan" → calibration_events + Pengaturan. Belum ada kirim WA otonom; matriks otonomi + ADR 0008 di Stage 06. Agen dijalankan via `arc ctl agents run`; tombol Analisis ulang menunggu Orchestrator (Stage 06).

stages.name: Orchestrator: siklus 6 tahap, konflik, otonomi, rencana, layar Orchestrator
stages.summary: internal/orchestrator: Run/Queue/Execute 6 tahap (cycle_stages + NOTIFY cycle_stage/cycle_done), satu siklus aktif (indeks unik → 409, advisory lock per skema), errgroup maks 4 agen, aturan Sintesis murni (suppression, followup_gap, dedupe covers/satu tawaran/sama jenis, credit_over_stock, collect_before_followup, margin_floor, one_owner), Evaluate otonomi (matriks + autonomy.guard), plan.Build (8 langkah pada seed: 3 otonom, 5 approve), Eksekusi (SO draft/credit hold, lepas langkah menunggu pembayaran, kirim otonom hanya bila guard auto), Belajar (agent_state confidence, few-shot dari edit, sinyal ditandai). Agen v1 AI Stok, AI Penagihan, AI Prospek. Job cycle.run (tiap jam 06–20 WIB + on-demand). API cycles/conflicts/agents/plan/policies autonomy, brief dari siklus. Web: kartu Orchestrator, Rencana hari ini, layar Orchestrator, Dock, Analisis ulang di Orbit/Segmen/Dealer/⌘K, reducer useCycle. CLI arc ctl reanalyze / cycle status. ADR 0008.
stages.notes: Fake LLM: siklus seed 105 ms; konflik credit_over_stock Mitra, collect_before_followup Nusa, margin_floor Indo (one_owner tidak menyala: seed tanpa chat Sarana dari dua sales). Deviasi mockup (rumus menang): bundle LED P5 −1,5% (bukan −8%: floor margin 9% dari modal Rp 500 rb/harga A Rp 560 rb), ke 2 dealer (bukan 6, PushCandidates glossary); langkah AI Order 13.00 diganti follow-up Nusa menunggu pembayaran; teks "dijalankan sendiri" → "otonom" (ADR 0008: pesan otonom ke dealer menunggu Jalankan sekarang). Panel MCP placeholder sampai Stage 07.
